title: Thermometer (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Thermometer applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Thermometer (BtnThermometer) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Thermometer fill cycle, clamping and state codec are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The fill cycle advances in 0.25 steps and wraps 1.0 back to 0, percentages clamp into the unit interval, and the persistent state codec keeps the historical 'oPen_Thermometer' tag literal and round-trips percentage (invariant) and color; the lenient reader keeps its documented defaults (0.5, 0x0000FF) for EE4P-compatible shapes.

scenarios.title: Thermometer creates exactly one shape in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Thermometer at 75 percent on an empty slide adds exactly one shape (measured shapeCountDelta=1), reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
